mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPI YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same period, it signals a robust demand environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% MoM AND UNRATE decreases > 0.2% MoM
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST increases > 5% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a tightening monetary policy in a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening in a slowing economy
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and GDPC1 YoY growth < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs per month signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases by > 200,000 jobs per month for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is above 3% YoY and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% YoY, it signals strong real economic growth without significant inflationary pressure, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY growth > 3% AND CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 YoY growth > 3% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.
